views.name: wyoming_city_population_with_median_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.city_name,
  c.population,
  -- median per state computed using percentile approximation via two-sided avg of middle values
  (SELECT AVG(x.population)
   FROM (
     SELECT population,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY population) AS rn,
            COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
     FROM city
     WHERE state_name = c.state_name
   ) x
   WHERE x.rn IN ( (x.cnt+1)/2, (x.cnt+2)/2 )
  ) AS state_median_population,
  CASE
    WHEN c.population IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN c.population > (
      SELECT AVG(x.population)
      FROM (
        SELECT population,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY population) AS rn,
               COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
        FROM city
        WHERE state_name = c.state_name
      ) x
      WHERE x.rn IN ( (x.cnt+1)/2, (x.cnt+2)/2 )
    ) THEN 'above_median'
    WHEN c.population < (
      SELECT AVG(x.population)
      FROM (
        SELECT population,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY population) AS rn,
               COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
        FROM city
        WHERE state_name = c.state_name
      ) x
      WHERE x.rn IN ( (x.cnt+1)/2, (x.cnt+2)/2 )
    ) THEN 'below_median'
    ELSE 'at_median'
  END AS population_classification
FROM city AS c
views.description: For cities in a specific state (filter applied in question_ops), expose city-level population plus the state's median city population and a flag/classification comparing city population to that median. Designed to be reusable for any state by applying a state filter later.

views.name: state_clean_numbers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  state_name,
  CASE
    WHEN typeof(population) IN ('integer','real') THEN population
    WHEN trim(population) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(population AS INTEGER)
  END AS population,
  CASE
    WHEN typeof(area) IN ('integer','real') THEN area
    WHEN trim(area) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(area AS REAL)
  END AS area,
  CASE
    WHEN
      (CASE
         WHEN typeof(population) IN ('integer','real') THEN population
         WHEN trim(population) = '' THEN NULL
         ELSE CAST(population AS INTEGER)
       END) IS NULL
      OR
      (CASE
         WHEN typeof(area) IN ('integer','real') THEN area
         WHEN trim(area) = '' THEN NULL
         ELSE CAST(area AS REAL)
       END) IS NULL
      OR
      (CASE
         WHEN typeof(area) IN ('integer','real') THEN area
         WHEN trim(area) = '' THEN NULL
         ELSE CAST(area AS REAL)
       END) = 0
    THEN NULL
    ELSE
      (CAST(
        (CASE
           WHEN typeof(population) IN ('integer','real') THEN population
           WHEN trim(population) = '' THEN NULL
           ELSE CAST(population AS INTEGER)
         END) AS REAL)
       /
       (CASE
           WHEN typeof(area) IN ('integer','real') THEN area
           WHEN trim(area) = '' THEN NULL
           ELSE CAST(area AS REAL)
        END)
      )
  END AS density
FROM state

semantic_filters.none: no row-filtering; cleaning only (casts and null-normalization)

views.description: Canonicalized numeric fields for states: ensures population and area are numeric and exposes a computed density field (NULL if inputs invalid). Useful for any questions that compute per-area or per-capita metrics.

views.name: state_demographics_summary

  s.state_name AS state_name,
  SUM(COALESCE(s.population, 0)) AS population,
  SUM(COALESCE(s.area, 0.0)) AS area,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(COALESCE(s.area, 0.0)) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE SUM(COALESCE(s.population, 0)) * 1.0 / SUM(COALESCE(s.area, 0.0))
  END AS density
FROM state s
GROUP BY s.state_name

semantic_filters.none: no cohort filter; include all state rows before aggregation

  s.population AS state_population,
  s.area AS state_area,
  s.capital AS state_capital,
  s.density AS state_density
FROM state s
LEFT JOIN city c ON c.state_name = s.state_name
